sheets.qa_notes: Thirteen pieces; three independent trunks, separate canopy/leaf frames/fog screen/grass, detached wire and three bulbs. No projected people baked in fog.

Six pier cards stage as three pairs.

sheets.qa_notes: Twelve pieces; sea and reflection strip separate, wall lamps detached and unlit, cloths independent from line. No people or ember on scenery.
dependency_notes: Root supplies tide board, porch light and ember.
Retain source two wall-lamp fixtures detached and unlit; no additional orange point lights.
